text:
ana (Product): quick sync — attaching the combined spec for chat/completions + embeddings + rerank fallback logic. want alignment on acceptance criteria before i turn this into a PRD.

drew (Eng): thanks. skimmed. biggest open: routing rules when a model variant fails the latency SLO. do we: 1) fallback to cheaper quantized shard, 2) route to another region, or 3) return an explicit error to caller?

sam (Eng-ML): prefer automated fallback order: quantized variant -> lower-seq-length variant -> regional fallback. only return 5xx if capacity exhausted. need rules for cache invalidation on fallback.

lisa (DevEx): for SDK ergonomics we'll expose a `fallback_policy` enum with values: `prefer_speed`, `prefer_cost`, `strict`. product default = `prefer_speed`. dev note: surface which fallback happened in streaming headers.

marta (Customer Success): customers with compliance needs will want to opt out of regional fallback. must add a `data_residency` flag that blocks region hops.

drew (Eng): ok add policy: if `data_residency: strict` then disallow region fallback; still allow quantized/model-variant fallback if model artifacts colocated.

tim (QA): acceptance checklist draft: 
- end-to-end smoke for chat/completions that triggers a controlled model OOM and validates fallback path chosen.
- embedding dimension and hashing stability tests (same input -> identical vector within float epsilon after rollback/upgrades).
- rerank consistency test: given same base embeddings, score delta between primary and fallback reranker <= 3% for top-10 ordering.
- header + event telemetry present for each fallback decision.

ana (Product): adding explicit launch gates I'm proposing: 
- Performance: 95th pctl latency for chat (<= 250ms token) on standard prompt profile.
- Correctness: rerank top-3 unchanged > 90% compared to golden set.
- Observability: fallback telemetry available in Console and event stream with clear tags.
- Security/GDPR: must honor `data_residency` per request.

drew (Eng): implementation notes: runtime will attach `x-redwood-fallback` header with values like `none`, `quantized-v1`, `lower-seq`, `region-us-west-2`. we should standardize the header and add to SDKs.

sam (Eng-ML): for embeddings: accept both float32 1536 and int8 quantized 1536. API shape: keep `dimension` in metadata and `format` = `float32` | `int8`. fallback scoring path must re-normalize vectors to same norm before rerank. add test for numeric drift.

lisa (DevEx): example API snippet for reference (we'll put in SDK README):
```json
POST /v1/embeddings
{
  "model": "rw-embed-1",
  "input": "...",
  "accept_format": ["float32","int8"]
}
```
response header `x-redwood-fallback` if applicable.

marta (Customer Success): can we add a customer opt-in `fallback_preview` flag so early adopters can see experimental fallback ordering? helpful for enterprise testing.

drew (Eng): ok support `fallback_preview` for orgs on beta tier; will toggle via flags. needs audit log entry.

tim (QA): also capture eval gating: run 1k queries sampled from customers and verify rerank MRR delta < 0.02 before rollout.

ana (Product): good. next steps: i'll update the doc with these acceptance criteria and the API header spec, then file a PRD draft. action items: @drew add header enum + implementation notes; @sam add embedding quantization tests and rerank normalization spec; @lisa add SDK surface + README snippet; @tim add QA playbook testcases; @marta confirm if `fallback_preview` needs contract docs for customers.

drew (Eng): will do. expect PR for runtime change + tests by EOW.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary rollout to non-prod fleet in 30m :rocket:

lisa (DevEx): thanks — i'll prep the SDK PR template. :thumbsup:

marta (Customer Success): tagging a customer who asked for routed fallbacks @bigbank — will show preview once feature flagged.

ana (Product): thanks team — i'll fold this into the PRD and ping for final review.
